drills.name: Partner Passing Progression
drills.description: Pairs 15 yards apart work through right-hand only, left-hand only, then quick-catch-and-throw. Twenty reps per phase.
drills.coachingPoints: Top hand to your ear, step to your target, snap the wrists through.

drills.name: Down-the-Line Passing on the Run
drills.description: Two lines face each other 20 yards apart. Player sprints toward the opposite line, passes on the run at the midpoint cone, and joins the back of that line.
drills.coachingPoints: Pass across your body while running. Don't stop your feet to throw.

drills.name: Quick Stick Triangle
drills.description: Three players form a ten-yard triangle and move one ball with one-touch catch-and-release passes. Add a second ball once the first is clean.
drills.coachingPoints: Soft hands, catch and release in one motion. The ball never sits in your stick.

drills.name: Wall Ball Circuit
drills.description: Each player faces a wall or rebounder: 25 right, 25 left, 25 quick sticks, 25 one-handed. Time the full circuit and race your own score.
drills.coachingPoints: Same clean mechanics at full speed. The wall punishes lazy hands.

drills.name: Shooting on the Run Arc
drills.description: Player sweeps across the top of the arc, receives a feed at the cone, and shoots on the run without breaking stride. Alternate sweeping from each wing.
drills.coachingPoints: Run through the shot with your hips and shoulders turning to the target.

drills.name: Time and Room Catch-and-Shoot
drills.description: Shooter catches a feed at 12 yards, steps into an overhand shot with full wind-up. Five shots, rotate feeder, shooter, and ball chaser.
drills.coachingPoints: Hands back as you catch, crow-hop, and shoot overhand down the pipe.

drills.name: Corner Placement Shooting
drills.description: Hang targets or call corners: each shooter gets five shots to hit the called corner from ten yards. Track makes; winner picks the next corner.
drills.coachingPoints: Look the corner in, aim for far pipe low. Placement beats power.

drills.name: Crease Feed and Finish
drills.description: Feeder at X, finisher posts on the crease. Finisher cuts across the mouth of the goal, catches, and finishes in one motion. Five reps, rotate.
drills.coachingPoints: Catch and finish in the same motion. Any cradle gives the goalie time.

drills.name: Split Dodge Cone Line
drills.description: Players dribble at a cone at three-quarter speed, execute a split dodge, and accelerate two hard steps out of it. Both directions, five reps each.
drills.coachingPoints: Sell the first direction, switch hands tight to your body, and burst.

drills.name: Roll Dodge Mirror
drills.description: Defender shadows at half speed with hands behind back; ball carrier drives, plants, and roll dodges away from pressure. Three reps, switch roles.
drills.coachingPoints: Plant, seal them on your back, and protect the stick on the far side.

drills.name: 1v1 from X
drills.description: Attacker starts behind the goal at X against one defender and has eight seconds to dodge topside and score. Rotate winner-stays.
drills.coachingPoints: Attack the island above goal line extended. Make the defender turn his hips.

drills.name: Change of Pace Alley
drills.description: Ball carrier jogs down a five-yard cone alley, then explodes to full speed at a random cone of their choosing, finishing with a shot on the run.
drills.coachingPoints: Lull them at jog speed. The burst only works if the slow looks real.

drills.name: Approach and Breakdown
drills.description: Defenders sprint from the crease toward a coach-held ball, break down into a controlled stance in the last three yards, and mirror two lateral moves.
drills.coachingPoints: Sprint, chop your feet, stick out front. Never arrive out of control.

drills.name: Poke and Lift Check Reps
drills.description: Ball carrier cradles at walking pace; defender throws controlled poke checks at the bottom hand and lift checks under the glove. Ten of each, switch.
drills.coachingPoints: Short, sharp checks that return to position. Never wind up or swing.

drills.name: Hot Slide Triangle
drills.description: Three defenders guard three attackers around the arc. On the coach's call of 'hot,' the nearest defender slides to the ball while the other two rotate to cover.
drills.coachingPoints: Call 'hot' early and loud. The slide starts with your voice, not your feet.

drills.name: Scoop Through Lines
drills.description: Coach rolls balls out; players attack the ball one at a time, scoop through without stopping, and cradle away to the back of the line.
drills.coachingPoints: Butt of the stick low, back flat, run through the ball. Never rake.

drills.name: 1v1 Ground Ball Battles
drills.description: Coach rolls a ball between two players standing shoulder to shoulder. Both fight to scoop; winner passes back to the coach for the point.
drills.coachingPoints: Get your body between the man and the ball before you scoop.

drills.name: Ground Ball to 3v2 Break
drills.description: Coach rolls a ground ball to three attackers; the player who scoops immediately leads a 3v2 fast break against two recovering defenders.
drills.coachingPoints: Scoop, head up, first pass ahead of the defense within two steps.
skillTags: Ground Balls: Ground ball to fast break

drills.name: Full-Field Clear Relay
drills.description: Goalie outlets to a defender, and the team moves the ball goal-to-goal through midfield cones with a minimum of four passes, finishing with a shot. Race the clock.
drills.coachingPoints: Move the ball faster than anyone can run. Pass ahead, never backward under pressure.

drills.name: Cut and Feed Circuit
drills.description: Ball rotates around the perimeter while one off-ball attacker at a time makes a V-cut or backdoor cut for a feed and finish. Rotate cutter each rep.
drills.coachingPoints: Cut at full speed with your stick up and ready before the ball arrives.

drills.name: Line Drill Down and Back
drills.description: Two lines face each other twenty yards apart. Player passes, follows his pass to the back of the opposite line, and the ball moves continuously. Three minutes each direction.
drills.coachingPoints: Top hand throws, bottom hand pulls. Give him a target box outside your helmet ear.

drills.name: Three-Man Star Passing
drills.description: Three players in a triangle pass in one direction for ninety seconds, then reverse. Add a second ball once the pattern is clean.
drills.coachingPoints: Call his name before you throw. Step to the pass, don't reach for it.

drills.name: Catch Away from the Body
drills.description: Partner deliberately throws passes wide, high, and behind from fifteen yards. Receiver has to move the stick to the ball and give with the catch. Twenty catches.
drills.coachingPoints: Move the head of the stick to the ball, not your feet to the stick. Soft hands, give it back a few inches.

drills.name: Two-Line Passing on the Move
drills.description: Players run parallel lanes fifteen yards apart passing back and forth the length of the field, then jog back and go again. Six trips.
drills.coachingPoints: Lead him so he never breaks stride. Turn your shoulders to throw, not your whole body.

drills.name: Give and Go Up the Alley
drills.description: Player passes to a stationary partner, sprints past him, and receives it back moving downfield. Eight reps each side, alternating strong and off hand.
drills.coachingPoints: Pass and accelerate, don't pass and watch. Catch it on the move out in front.

drills.name: Cross-Field Skip Pass
drills.description: Player catches on one wing and skips the ball across the field to the opposite wing over a cone standing in for a defender. Eight reps each direction.
drills.coachingPoints: Get your hands away from your body and throw over the top. Flat and hard beats high and pretty.

drills.name: Quick Stick Box
drills.description: Four players at the corners of a ten yard box catch and release in one motion without cradling. Ninety seconds each direction, then add a second ball.
drills.coachingPoints: Catch and release in one motion, no cradle. Stick stays up and ready before it gets there.

drills.name: Quick Stick Off the Rebounder
drills.description: Player throws into a rebounder from ten yards and returns the bounce in one motion without letting the ball settle. Thirty reps each hand.
drills.coachingPoints: Soft top hand on the catch, push it right back. Never let the ball sit in the pocket.

drills.name: Crease Quick Stick Feeds
drills.description: Feeder from behind the goal delivers to a cutter on the crease who has to catch and shoot in one motion. Eight reps each side.
drills.coachingPoints: Stick head up where he can hit it. Redirect it, don't wind up.

drills.name: Off-Hand Only Line Drill
drills.description: Same down-and-back line drill but every throw and catch must be off hand. Any strong-hand rep sends the player to the back of the line. Three minutes.
drills.coachingPoints: Switch the hands, don't switch the body. Ugly and off hand beats pretty and predictable.

drills.name: Switch Hands on the Whistle
drills.description: Players cradle and pass with a partner, switching hands every time the coach blows the whistle at random intervals. Three minutes continuous.
drills.coachingPoints: Switch high across your chest, never down by your waist. Protect it through the switch.

drills.name: Far Pipe Finish on the Move
drills.description: Attacker carries across the top of the box and finishes at the far pipe while still moving away from it. Eight reps in each direction.
drills.coachingPoints: Shoot across your body to the far pipe. The goalie is already sliding, put it where he came from.

drills.name: Question Mark Curl Shot
drills.description: Player carries from behind the goal, curls up the side in a question mark path, and shoots on the move from eight yards. Six reps each side.
drills.coachingPoints: Turn the corner tight to the crease. Shoot before you square up or the slide is already there.

drills.name: Catch, Step, Shoot
drills.description: Player catches a feed while standing still at twelve yards, steps toward the cage, and shoots overhand. Ten reps each hand.
drills.coachingPoints: Hands away from the body, full rotation through the hips. Catch it ready to shoot, not ready to cradle.

drills.name: Time and Room Under Pressure
drills.description: Shooter gets a feed at twelve yards with a defender closing from six yards away, so he has about one second. Eight reps alternating sides.
drills.coachingPoints: Decide before the catch. If he is on you, shoot low and away from the stick.

drills.name: Corner Target Ladder
drills.description: Shooting targets hang in all four corners of the goal. Shooter calls a corner before each shot and works through all four twice from ten yards.
drills.coachingPoints: Pick the corner before you catch it. Low corners beat a goalie more than high ones at this age.

drills.name: Off-Hip Shot Selection
drills.description: Shooter works from both wings and has to shoot away from the goalie's stick side every time, which means far side low from one wing and near side from the other. Eight reps each side.
drills.coachingPoints: Shoot away from his stick, not away from his body. Change the angle with your feet first.

drills.name: Bounce Shot Reps
drills.description: Shooter works only bounce shots from ten yards, aiming to land the ball two to three feet in front of the goal line. Twelve shots each hand.
drills.coachingPoints: Land it just in front of his feet so it jumps at the last second. Follow through down, not across.

drills.name: Inside Roll and Finish
drills.description: Attacker starts on the crease with his back to the goal, rolls off a defender's pressure, and finishes inside five yards. Six reps each shoulder.
drills.coachingPoints: Protect the stick with your body through the roll. Finish quick, you get one look inside.

drills.name: Backdoor Cut Finish
drills.description: Cutter starts above the crease, sells a move toward the ball, then cuts backdoor for a feed and a one-motion finish. Eight reps alternating sides.
drills.coachingPoints: Sell it toward the ball first. Stick head up and away from the goalie as you cut.

drills.name: Rebound Crash and Finish
drills.description: Coach shoots from outside and two crease players crash for the rebound and put it back before the goalie resets. Ten reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Follow every shot, most goals at this age come off a rebound. Scoop it and shoot in the same motion.

drills.name: Split Dodge in Traffic
drills.description: Two passive defenders stand four yards apart and the dodger has to split through the narrow lane between them without slowing down. Eight reps from each side.
drills.coachingPoints: Tight space means a quick, small split. Get your hands through first and your hips follow.

drills.name: Split Dodge vs Live Defender
drills.description: Dodger takes on a defender playing breakdown position from twelve yards and must beat him with a split. Four reps each, then switch roles.
drills.coachingPoints: Make him open his hips first, then split back. If he doesn't move, you didn't sell it.

drills.name: Roll Dodge Off the Wing
drills.description: Dodger drives toward the goal from the wing, gets stopped, and rolls back the other way while protecting the stick. Six reps each side.
drills.coachingPoints: Roll off his hip, not away from it. Stick stays inside your body the whole turn.

drills.name: Roll Back to Pass
drills.description: Dodger rolls away from pressure and immediately feeds a cutter rather than shooting. Eight reps, alternating which shoulder he rolls over.
drills.coachingPoints: Your eyes come up as you finish the roll. The roll buys you a pass, not always a shot.

drills.name: X to the Island
drills.description: Attacker starts behind the goal at X and dodges to the island spot on either side, aiming to get his hands free above goal line extended. Four reps each side.
drills.coachingPoints: Get your hips past the pipe before you look up. Above goal line extended or it's not a shot.

drills.name: X Dodge and Feed
drills.description: Dodger works from X while two teammates fill the crease and wing. He must draw the slide and feed rather than force the shot. Eight reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Draw him, then move it. The second defender commits, somebody is open.

drills.name: Two-Speed Approach
drills.description: Dodger jogs at the defender for five yards, then explodes past him on a change of pace with no stick move at all. Eight reps each side.
drills.coachingPoints: Slow to fast beats fast to faster. Make him relax, then go.

drills.name: Hesitation and Face Dodge
drills.description: Dodger hesitates at the defender, brings the stick across his face to the other side, and finishes north. Six reps each direction.
drills.coachingPoints: Bring it across your face, not around your head. Explode the second the stick clears.

drills.name: Dodge to a Second Move
drills.description: Dodger uses one move at the first cone and a different move at the second five yards later, because the first one rarely beats a good defender. Six reps each combination.
drills.coachingPoints: Second move is the real one. Never stop your feet between the two.

drills.name: 1v1 from the Wing
drills.description: Live one-on-one starting at the wing twelve yards out. Dodger gets one possession of six seconds against a defender playing honest. Four reps each.
drills.coachingPoints: Attack his front foot. Get your hands free or move it, don't dodge into a double.

drills.name: Breakdown on the Whistle
drills.description: Defenders sprint toward a coach and drop into a breakdown position on the whistle, then shuffle three steps each way. Ten reps at increasing approach speed.
drills.coachingPoints: Break down two sticks away, not on top of him. Butt down, feet moving before he moves.

drills.name: Drop Step and Recover
drills.description: Defender shuffles laterally, the coach points past him, and he opens with a drop step, sprints three yards, and re-establishes breakdown position. Eight reps each side.
drills.coachingPoints: Open the hips, don't backpedal. Get back in front before you start checking.

drills.name: Poke Check Timing
drills.description: Defender shadows a dodger moving at half speed and throws a poke check only when the dodger's hands are away from his body. Ten reps, counting good timing rather than takeaways.
drills.coachingPoints: Poke at his hands, then get it back. One hand out, one hand on, feet never stop.

drills.name: Lift and Trail Check
drills.description: Defender trails a cutter and practices lifting the bottom hand of the stick just as a pass arrives. Eight reps each side at controlled speed.
drills.coachingPoints: Lift the bottom hand, not the head of the stick. Time it to the catch, not before.

drills.name: Check Discipline Shadow
drills.description: Defender shadows a dodger for a full ten second possession and is not allowed to throw a single check, only move his feet. Four reps each.
drills.coachingPoints: Your feet are the check. If you can stop him without your stick, you can stop anybody.

drills.name: Topside Denial Positioning
drills.description: Defender plays a dodger on the wing with the job of forcing him under toward the goal line rather than topside toward the middle. Six reps each side.
drills.coachingPoints: Stay a half step above him. Force him under, the goalie owns that angle.

drills.name: Hold the Crease Position
drills.description: Defender plays a crease attacker who is trying to seal for a feed. Defender must stay between him and the ball without a hold penalty. Six reps of ten seconds each.
drills.coachingPoints: Stay on his hands side, feel him with your forearm. Move your feet, don't grab.

drills.name: Slide and Fill Triangle
drills.description: Three defenders cover three attackers. When the ball carrier beats his man, the adjacent defender slides and the third fills behind him. Ten reps with the dodger changing each time.
drills.coachingPoints: Slide early, fill immediately. The second slide is what actually saves the goal.

drills.name: Recover to Your Man
drills.description: After sliding to stop the ball, the defender has to sprint back to his own man on the flight of the pass and contest the shot. Eight reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Recover on the pass, not after the catch. Sprint back, don't jog back.

drills.name: Goalie Arc and Step to the Ball
drills.description: Goalie works his arc between the pipes as a coach moves the ball around the perimeter, then steps to each shot with the top hand leading. Twenty shots from varied angles.
drills.coachingPoints: Step at the ball, not across the goal. Top hand drives to the shot, body follows.

drills.name: Goalie Low Shot Reps
drills.description: Coach feeds only low and bounce shots from ten yards so the goalie practices dropping the stick head and stepping down. Twenty shots, ten each side.
drills.coachingPoints: Hands drive down and out, knee follows the stick. Low shots are saved with the stick, not the feet.

drills.name: Goalie Outlet and Clear Start
drills.description: Goalie makes a save, steps out of the crease, and delivers an outlet pass to a defender breaking up the sideline. Twelve reps alternating sides.
drills.coachingPoints: Save it, then find the outlet before you run. Four seconds out of the crease and the ball is gone.

drills.name: Off-Hand Scoop Reps
drills.description: Players scoop stationary and rolling balls using the off hand on the bottom of the stick only. Fifteen reps, then fifteen more finishing with an off-hand pass.
drills.coachingPoints: Off hand low on the shaft, back still flat. It will feel wrong for a week, then it won't.

drills.name: Scoop and Protect
drills.description: After scooping, the player immediately brings the stick to a protected cradle position by his ear while jogging five yards. Fifteen reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Scoop, stick up, turn away from pressure. The ball is not yours until it's protected.

drills.name: Rolling Ball Scoops
drills.description: Coach rolls balls away from, toward, and across the player, who has to adjust his approach angle for each. Five reps of each direction.
drills.coachingPoints: Get your feet beside the ball before you scoop. Run through it, don't stop over it.

drills.name: Box Out the Ground Ball
drills.description: Two players start back to back over a ball. On the whistle each tries to seal the other out with his body before scooping. Six reps each pairing.
drills.coachingPoints: Body on him first, then the ball. Wide base and hips low.

drills.name: Two-on-One Ground Ball
drills.description: Two teammates and one opponent chase the same loose ball. One teammate boxes out while the other scoops, so the reps teach who does which job. Eight reps.
drills.coachingPoints: First man boxes, second man scoops. Call it loud so you don't both go for the ball.

drills.name: Ground Ball to Outlet
drills.description: Player scoops a contested ball and immediately finds an outlet teammate breaking upfield rather than carrying it himself. Ten reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Scoop, protect, then look up. Your first pass is worth twenty yards of running.
skillTags: Ground Balls: Ground ball to fast break

drills.name: Scoop and Break to 3v2
drills.description: Coach rolls a ball into the middle and three players scoop and immediately push into a three-on-two at the far goal. Eight reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Push it the second you have it. The break is already won or lost in the first three steps.
skillTags: Ground Balls: Ground ball to fast break

drills.name: Faceoff Clamp and Rake
drills.description: Two players set up in a faceoff stance and work the clamp on the whistle, then rake the ball back and out to a wing. Twelve reps alternating who wins the clamp.
drills.coachingPoints: Hands quick, hips down. Clamp and move it out, don't sit on it.

drills.name: Faceoff Exit Moves
drills.description: Faceoff players work three exits off the clamp: pull back to themselves, push forward, and rake to the open side. Six reps of each.
drills.coachingPoints: Pick the exit before the whistle based on where your wings are. Get it out of the middle fast.

drills.name: Wing Play off the Faceoff
drills.description: Wing players start on the line and sprint in on the whistle, one crashing toward the ball and one releasing to support. Ten reps with the faceoff live.
drills.coachingPoints: One wing crashes, one wing backs up. Decide before the whistle, not during.
skillTags: Ground Balls: Ground ball to fast break

drills.name: Cone Weave Speed and Agility
drills.description: Players weave through six cones set five yards apart carrying a stick, then sprint fifteen yards out the end. Four trips with walk-back rest.
drills.coachingPoints: Cut off the outside foot, don't round the cone. Stick stays in a protected position the whole way.

drills.name: Lateral Shuffle and Sprint
drills.description: Player shuffles ten yards laterally in a defensive posture, then turns and sprints twenty yards upfield. Six reps each direction.
drills.coachingPoints: Never cross your feet on the shuffle. Open the hips to turn and go, don't spin.

drills.name: Ten-Yard Dodging Starts
drills.description: Player starts from a jog, explodes ten yards on the whistle as if beating a defender, then decelerates under control. Eight reps with full recovery.
drills.coachingPoints: First two steps decide the dodge. Lean forward, don't stand up.

drills.name: Partner Resisted Starts
drills.description: One player provides light resistance at a partner's waist for the first five yards, then releases so he finishes at full speed. Six reps each, then switch.
drills.coachingPoints: Drive the knees, stay low through the resistance. Explode when he lets go.

drills.name: Box to Box Transition Runs
drills.description: Players sprint from the defensive box to the offensive box, jog back to the midline, and go again. Eight repetitions at game tempo.
drills.coachingPoints: Sprint the change of possession, jog the reset. That's exactly how the game runs.

drills.name: Substitution Box Sprints
drills.description: Players run on and off through the substitution box at full speed, touching the sideline each time. Ten cycles at game tempo with a stick in hand.
drills.coachingPoints: Full speed on and off, never jog through the box. Call your name to your replacement.

drills.name: Up-Down-Up Field Runs
drills.description: Players run the length of the field, back to midfield, and the length again at a steady tempo. Three full sets with ninety seconds between.
drills.coachingPoints: Hold the same pace all three sets. Breathe through your nose to check your tempo.

drills.name: Four-Minute Possession Run
drills.description: Six-on-six continuous play with no stoppages where a score or a turnover means the other team immediately pushes the other way. Four minute blocks, two rounds.
drills.coachingPoints: Nobody stands still. When you are tired, move the ball instead of carrying it.

drills.name: Bodyweight and Core Circuit
drills.description: Four stations at forty seconds each: push-ups, squats, side planks, and glute bridges. Two rounds with a minute between.
drills.coachingPoints: Full range or stop the set. Hips stay level on every plank.

drills.name: Four-on-Three Break
drills.description: Four attackers push against three defenders in a triangle. Ball must be moved at least twice before a shot, so the reps teach reading the rotation. Ten possessions.
drills.coachingPoints: Move it, don't carry it. Second pass is the one that scores.

drills.name: Five-on-Four Slow Break
drills.description: Offense pushes with a one man advantage that the defense is already partly set against, so the ball has to be swung to find the open man. Ten possessions.
drills.coachingPoints: Swing it side to side until somebody is genuinely open. Don't settle for the first look.

drills.name: Push the Break on the Save
drills.description: Goalie makes a save and the whole unit immediately releases into a break while two defenders ride. Ten reps, counting how many reach a shot inside eight seconds.
drills.coachingPoints: Release on the save, not on the outlet. Wide lanes, fill the middle last.

drills.name: Banana Clear Lanes
drills.description: Clearing unit moves the ball up the sideline in curved support lanes rather than straight lines, so the ball carrier always has two options. Eight clears against a light ride.
drills.coachingPoints: Run a banana, not a straight line, so you stay in his vision. Never stand still on a clear.

drills.name: Clear Against the Ten-Man Ride
drills.description: Defense clears against a full ride with the goalie as the extra man. If the clear fails, the riding team gets the ball at the restraining line. Ten clears.
drills.coachingPoints: Use the goalie, he is the free man. Get it across the midline before you look upfield.

drills.name: Failed Clear Reset
drills.description: Clearing unit is deliberately pressured into a dead end and has to reverse the ball to the goalie and restart on the other side. Eight reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Back to the goalie is not a failure, it's a reset. Change the side and go again.

drills.name: Cut and Replace Circle
drills.description: Five offensive players move the ball around the perimeter with a rule that every cutter through the middle must be replaced by the man behind him. Three minutes continuous.
drills.coachingPoints: Cut hard and get out. Somebody fills your spot every single time.

drills.name: Off-Ball Pick Away
drills.description: Two off-ball attackers set picks for each other on the weak side while the ball carrier dodges on the strong side. Eight reps, alternating which side dodges.
drills.coachingPoints: Set the pick where the defender can't see it coming. Cutter waits for the pick, not the other way round.

drills.name: Man-Up Box Rotation
drills.description: Six attackers in a box set move the ball around a five man defense, looking for the extra man before shooting. Ten possessions of thirty seconds each.
drills.coachingPoints: One more pass than feels comfortable. The shot comes from the fifth pass, not the second.

drills.name: Man-Down Rotation Slides
drills.description: Five defenders cover six attackers, rotating on every pass so the extra man never gets a clean look. Ten possessions with the coach calling out who is late.
drills.coachingPoints: Rotate on the pass, not on the catch. Somebody is always open, make it the guy furthest from the goal.

drills.name: Ride to Force the Turnover
drills.description: Six attackers ride a clearing team, using the sideline as a trap and funneling the ball carrier toward a double. Ten rides, counting forced turnovers.
drills.coachingPoints: Angle him to the sideline, never let him turn back to the middle. Ride as a group or don't ride at all.

drills.name: Ground Ball War Lines
drills.description: Two lines face each other ten yards apart with a coach between them. He rolls a ball to either side and the first man from each line competes for it, then the winner clears it to a target. Sixteen reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Get there first and get low. If you can't win it, make sure he can't either.
